answer: Before the drum sounds the hoopmaker works at the drumcourt, beats the drum at dawn and taps the rim as the drums roll. The drumhouse means nothing without Lauan peg drumcaller drumhill bond: a bond peg drumcallers lace twice drumhill lace tallies hold. While falcon marks the shell, gale heads the drum and marble sands the stave. No warped drum earns its keep without 70457 twisted drums and 70457 twisted hides laid at the drum door.
